:::{#rem-cv-se}
#### The standard error is only a rough guide

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1] draw standard-error bars
computed from the per-fold errors as in @eq-cv-se.
That formula treats the $k$ fold errors
as if they were independent,
which they are not:
every pair of folds shares $k - 2$ folds of training data.
So $\cvse$ is a rough indication
of how much $\cvest{k}$ might change with a different sample,
not an exact [standard error](estimation.qmd#def-SE).

:::
